about.heading: About me
about.paragraph1: I am almost a Computer Technician, interested in technology since childhood. My curiosity took me from hardware repair to setting up my own personal homelab with Linux for hosting services with Docker.
about.paragraph2: In programming, I have carried out backend tasks mostly oriented to relational databases and their application in web systems.

database.title: Database: Student Management
